tweets.name: Vivienne Ashcroft
tweets.text: Week 8 opens tonight with Corbishley vs Charles — the second seed visiting the first seed, sixteen trades against the measuring stick, and a league that still hasn't decided if the 2025 regular-season title means anything without the ring. The Ledger is watching every point.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: 8-4 on the season, locks at 2-0, and I have been saying for three weeks that Corbishley is the most dangerous team in this league to bet against. Whatever I put on the Week 8 card is informed by that track record and I expect it to be treated accordingly at the desk.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: Buddy, Kevin is 11-3 with 937 points forced and sitting on a collision course with Mitchum — who just went +8.4% to $102.21 on the exchange — and somehow the whole building is only talking about the top matchup. I am covering Kevin vs Mitchum like a main event because it is a main event.

tweets.name: Chad Bellwether
tweets.text: Fronge beat Ryan last week 121-114.6, is now 7-7, relocated to Havana, has zero pick liquidity, and this week draws Wingard at 4-10. FORG is somehow the safest line on the board right now and I don't love admitting that about a team that operates out of Cuba.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: Fresh start, new week, full focus on the matchups. Jake vs Shaq is underrated — two 7-7 and 6-8 teams, both carrying a TE hole, and ECHO dropped to $94.99 while MWB craters at $88.36 down 9.5%. One of these rosters has a real WR room and one of them is about to find out.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: I called the Mitchum surge before anyone else on this desk and DEEP at $102.21 — up 8.4% — is the exchange confirming what I put in print. Now they have Kevin this week and the question is whether the floor is real or whether it was just a slow schedule catching up.

tweets.name: Clara Hopkins
tweets.text: MWB down 9.5% to $88.36 in the same week Shaq faces Jake, and we still have not gotten a single Monarch trade to solve the RB situation that has been empty for two consecutive offseasons. The Ledger is not writing that the WR wealth is a long-term plan. Not again.

tweets.name: Big Dog
tweets.text: Drew is 0-14 and somehow ATLAS closed at $38.25, up 8.4%. I have been in this business long enough to know that when the cheapest listing in exchange history starts moving, someone is either very smart or very bored, and the 0-14 record has not yet given me evidence of the former.

tweets.name: Matteo Honeydew
tweets.text: Rankings are unavailable this run but I will say this freely: Adam is 3-11 and has won three of his last four games. HLX at $76.25 is not reflecting that. The model doesn't care that the record looks bad — the production trend is real and Ryan at 7-7 is walking into a week he should not be comfortable about.

tweets.name: Vance Hollis
tweets.text: WINGARD BEAT CHARLES 117.7-107.3 LAST WEEK. 4-10 OVER 12-2. SDR AT $50.75 IS DOWN 6.2% AND THE MARKET IS STILL DISCOUNTING THIS TEAM LIKE THEY DIDN'T JUST HAND THE NUMBER ONE SEED ITS WORST LOSS OF THE SEASON. FRONGE THIS WEEK BUT THE POINT STANDS.
